Anna: Quick mock — small inline 'Preview' in run history so QA can peek tool outputs. https://redwood.in/s/preview-mini
Leo: Modal or inline expansion?
Priya: Inline. Keeps timeline context and keyboard flow.
Sam: Add a 1-line summary on collapsed row: 'Output: ok — 3 keys — schema valid' for fast scans.
Rui: Need to snapshot outputs at run-time. /snapshots endpoint, retention 90d.
Priya: A11y: on expand move focus to panel header, aria-expanded on toggle, aria-live for streaming.
Sam: Micro-diff idea when rerun shows small changed tokens + 'Full diff' action.
Anna: CTA copy — 'Send to QA' vs 'Handoff to QA'? Lean lighter.
Rui: Also store content-hash to dedupe identical snapshots.
qa-bot: Created ticket #298: run-history inline preview + snapshot https://redwood.in/t/298
Anna: I'll update Figma with compact summary, tabs (Inputs/Structured/Schema), and a11y notes. Thanks!
